parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape and compartments of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds other components like shelves and doors.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support panel of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: An internal shelf made of MDF, used to divide the cabinet space into sections.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and helps organize the cabinet interior.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: Another internal shelf made of MDF, similar to the previous one, dividing the cabinet vertically.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage levels for organizing items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is made of solid wood and attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet interior and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A third internal shelf made of MDF, forming another level of storage inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed inside the cabinet and helps organize storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.
